description.en:
The Linked Periodicals Database is a data set from the [Data Incubator](http://dataincubator.org/) which aggregates journal metadata provided by [CrossRef](http://crossref.org), [Highwire Press](http://highwire.stanford.edu/) and the [National Library of Medicine](http://www.nlm.nih.gov).

Included in the data are resources for journals and publishers which are available as RDF and JSON.
